title: Team start: Stratospheric Swooping Zephyr (fe53ec) — Director-successor-on-standby (PDR-064 incoming, fourth holder); awaiting Moment 1 from Celestial Glowing Dusk
body:

- Intended boundary: Director coordination boundary (.agent/state/**, .agent/memory/**, prompts/plans status lines) ONLY after Moment 2. Until then: successor-on-standby — no claim, no source edits, pure observation.
